title: Toolset
description: <.jad>/tools/<category>/<name>.json. The tools a profile can use and how each one is configured. The name is the file name.

name.description: Display name of the toolset, shown beside its ID in the catalog editor. Changes no behavior; defaults to the ID.

native.description: Native tool settings, key by key as tools.native in setting.schema.json. A tool listed here is enabled; a tool not listed is not.

extension.description: Extension tool settings (tools that call a provider API), key by key as tools.extension in setting.schema.json. A tool listed here is enabled; a tool not listed is not.

hooks.description: Commands around tool calls (post_edit, pre_tool, post_tool), key by key as hooks in setting.schema.json. Set hooks here or in the settings, not both: a toolset that sets hooks while the defaults, session or profile settings also set it is a config error. A sub-agent that names this toolset runs these hooks.

mcp.description: MCP servers this toolset enables. Each key is <category>/<name> of a file under mcp/, for example "browser-headed/betterwright". The file holds the connection and its environment; here only how this toolset uses it. Two keys with the same file name are refused: they would give the same tool names.

resources.description: Adds two tools for the server's resources: one lists them (or their URI templates) a page at a time, one reads a resource by URI. A server that does not offer resources fails the run with this key named.

prompts.description: Adds two tools for the server's prompt templates: one lists them with their arguments, one returns a prompt filled with its arguments. A server that does not offer prompts fails the run with this key named.
